Container.Name: cert-rotator
Container.Overview:
Keeps the Alexa Smart Home mTLS client certificate alive.
It renews short-lived client certificates from your own step-ca and publishes the renewed certificate to an AWS SSM SecureString parameter, where the Alexa Lambda reads it. Nothing needs to be done by hand every 90 days.
Authentication to AWS uses IAM Roles Anywhere: the container presents its own certificate (issued by your CA) and receives credentials that last one hour and can write exactly one SSM parameter. No AWS access key is stored on this server.
BEFORE YOU START: 1. Deploy cfn/rotation.yaml to AWS; it prints the three ARNs below. 2. Issue a rotator certificate whose common name matches the one in that stack (default: cert-rotator). 3. Put rotator.crt, rotator.key, alexa-lambda.crt, alexa-lambda.key and root_ca.crt in the certs folder.
See docs/rotation.md in the project repository for the exact commands.

Branch.TagDescription: Latest build from the main branch

Config.Name: certs
Config.Description: Container Path: /certs - holds root_ca.crt, alexa-lambda.crt/.key and rotator.crt/.key. The renewed certificates are written back here.

Config.Name: CA URL
Config.Description: URL of your step-ca, e.g. https://192.168.1.10:9000. The hostname or IP must be one of the CA's configured DNS names.

Config.Name: SSM Parameter
Config.Description: SSM SecureString parameter the renewed client certificate is written to. Must match MtlsParamName in the Lambda stack.

Config.Name: AWS Region
Config.Description: Region holding the SSM parameter (same region as the Alexa Lambda).

Config.Name: Trust Anchor ARN
Config.Description: TrustAnchorArn output of the rotation CloudFormation stack. Leave empty to use ordinary AWS credentials instead of IAM Roles Anywhere.

Config.Name: Profile ARN
Config.Description: ProfileArn output of the rotation CloudFormation stack.

Config.Name: Role ARN
Config.Description: RoleArn output of the rotation CloudFormation stack.

Config.Name: Renew Before
Config.Description: Renew once the certificate has less than this long to live. 720h is 30 days.

Config.Name: Check Interval
Config.Description: How long to sleep between checks. Checks are cheap; renewal only happens inside the window above.

Config.Name: Run Once
Config.Description: Set to true to check once and exit, for running from cron or User Scripts instead of leaving the container up.

Config.Name: Notifiarr API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Sends a passthrough notification when a certificate rotates or a run fails.
